title: The Normal Comes From Outside: A Sphere Beyond the Sphere
title_zh: 法线从外面来：球外之球
summary: Living inside a flat sheet, can you point to the sheet's own up? Every arrow drawn in the sheet is a e₁ + b e₂ and stays in it. Placed in a three-dimensional room, the sheet gets its normal e₃ = ⋆₃(e₁ ∧ e₂) = (0, 0, 1), at right angles to e₁ and e₂: the up comes from outside. For the whole room, ⋆₃I₃ = 1 is a number, not a fourth arrow; one dimension down, a unit circle in a plane becomes the equator of a sphere once one new direction ±e₃ is added, and the radius stays 1 (at height 3/5 the slice has radius 4/5). Standing on one axis, a direction reads the cosine of its angle to it: the poles read 1 and −1, the whole equator reads 0. Six opposite directions mixed equally average to the centre, ρ = ½I; two directions 60° apart mixed half and half give an arrow of length √3/2 ≈ 0.866. These numbers are computed on screen. Lean checks that every positive semidefinite 2 × 2 complex matrix M has ‖bloch M‖ ≤ Re tr M, so a state's arrow is at most 1 long. The echo of Gödel is the book's analogy (argued), with its exact theorems in chapter 21.
summary_zh: 住在一张平平的薄片里，你能指出薄片自己的“上”吗？薄片里画出的每一支箭头都是 a e₁ + b e₂，都留在薄片之内。把薄片放进三维房间，它有了法线 e₃ = ⋆₃(e₁ ∧ e₂) = (0, 0, 1)，与 e₁、e₂ 都成直角：“上”来自外面。对整间房间，⋆₃I₃ = 1 只是一个数，不是第四根箭头；退一维看，平面里的单位圆添上一个新方向 ±e₃ 后成了球的赤道，半径仍是 1（高度 3/5 处的截圆半径为 4/5）。站在一根轴上，每个方向读出它与这根轴夹角的余弦：两极读出 1 与 −1，整条赤道读出 0。六个相反方向等量混合，平均落回球心，ρ = ½I；相隔 60° 的两个方向各取一半，箭头长度为 √3/2 ≈ 0.866。这些数都在屏幕上算出。Lean 检验：每个 2 × 2 复半正定矩阵 M 都满足 ‖bloch M‖ ≤ Re tr M，因此一个态的箭头长度不超过 1。哥德尔的回声是本书的类比（论证，未经内核检验），严格的定理见第 21 章。
